⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Excellent Fitness Holiday Experience

I completed the 10-day all-inclusive fitness program at Palapon in Hua Hin and it was fantastic! The Muay Thai training was a highlight for me, along with the refreshing morning walks.

All the trainers are very professional and friendly, which made the experience even better. Special thanks to Klaus and Tom for their support and encouragement throughout the program - they really kept me motivated!

The program is well-structured and keeps you focused on your goals.

I highly recommend this gym for anyone who wants to focus on their fitness in a supportive environment. Well worth it!

I was here on the weightloss program:

Lets get one things straight if you are going here, you are not going on a lazy holiday. You will be suffering at times.
If you want to be pampered, go to a luxury resort.

But if you do it well, it can be a (life) changing experience in becoming more physically active and healthy person. What was exactly my goal.

Not that I wasn't a happy person,  but my habits  and physique weren't like I wanted them and somehow i couldn't make that change on my own.

Don't expect Klaus and his team to change that over night, but if your are in the right mindset the are a really huge help in the right direction!

I made great progress during my stay and not only physically, that is something very positive and valuable i will take home. Next to some beautiful memories and precious friends i made there.  A shared goal will unite 😊.

In a bit under eight weeks my weight went down from 123,9 to 108 kilo.
That is a loss of 15,9 kilo🥳
(35 pounds). I feel great and sometimes I almost don't recognise myself in the mirror 😆.

Early 2024 I underwent surgery on my belly and was still experiencing pain of that when i came to Palapon in November'25.
But since my stay then no more pain.

If you think your stay is going to be an easy ride let me warn you:

Unless you are used to working out and fastening, you will suffer, experience pain, feel sorry for yourself,  ask yourself what the h*** have i started.
At times I found my self whining like a little cry baby. Although that isn't my style.
At those times I found Klaus and Tom a great help, listening and getting me back motivated.

Thank you, @Klaus and @Tom for listening to my whining every "now and then". Klaus thanks for the very subtle (sometimes less subtle 😂)kicks under my butt to get me motivated and going again.

"Life is like riding a bicycle. To keep your balance, you must keep moving!
Team Palapon,  thanks for the push i needed!

This was my second time at Palapon, and it was just as incredible as the first. I spent three weeks there, lost 14kg, and gained a huge amount of flexibility. Klaus, the owner, truly knows his craft. If you trust his guidance and commit 100% to the program, the results can be extraordinary.

I’m a 55-year-old man who works too hard and often neglects giving my body the care it deserves. My visits to Palapon act as a complete reset — setting me back on the right path physically and mentally.

What I love most about the camp is its simplicity and functionality. Yes, there are other camps with flashy juice bars and the latest shiny gym equipment, but those things can be distractions. Palapon is more raw — spotlessly clean, fully equipped with everything you genuinely need, supported by fantastic trainers and staff. It provides the space to truly focus on your body and mind.

One of the nicest surprises during both of my stays has been the other guests. There’s such a mix of nationalities and fitness levels, people at different stages of their lives — yet everyone comes together with one shared goal: to better themselves.

A few tips if you go:

The first three days are the hardest — stick with it. By day five, you’ll start feeling amazing.

Don’t argue with the Muay Thai trainers — it will only cost you more sit-ups.

Trust Mr. Klaus — he knows exactly what he’s doing and will get you where you want to be.

Enjoy Sundays — the well-earned day of rest at Palapon.

Would I recommend Palapon 100%
Would I go again - in a heart beat

I recently completed the 10-day all-inclusive program, and as a corporate worker with very little exercise beforehand, I’ll be honest — it was incredibly tough at first. But it turned out to be one of the best decisions I’ve made for myself.

The team were exceptionally supportive, motivating, and encouraging every single day. No judgement, just constant positivity and belief that I could do more than I thought possible. That support is what kept me going when things felt hard.

The all-inclusive food was great — healthy, filling, and aligned with the program. Not having to think about meals made it so much easier to stay focused on training and recovery.

This experience has given me real momentum and confidence and was the perfect launchpad for my 2026 fitness goals. Thank you Klaus, Tom and the team.

After a disc prolapse in December 2024 and subsequent surgery, I thought my active life was over. Then I started personal training with Klaus Lippert at Palapon in Hua Hin – and it changed everything.

I’ve been doing 2–3 private sessions per week with Klaus, and the results are incredible. He’s a true expert in the latest science on nutrition, muscle building, and functional strength training. Forget the old “lift heavy weights” myth – Klaus’s techniques are far more focused, intense, and effective. You have to experience it to believe it.

Most other fitness programs in town feel like generic scams. Klaus’s personal training is completely different: tailored to me, evidence-based, and built to rebuild my body properly after surgery and years of neglect.

My back is stronger than ever, pain-free, and I’ve gained real functional strength. This has truly transformed my life.

If you need serious, personalized results – especially after injury or surgery – book private sessions with Klaus at Palapon. 5 stars aren’t enough!
Highly recommend!

All in all big thanks to Klaus, the owner of Palapon, and all his great staff.

We stayed at Palapon for 10 days and it was absolutely fantastic. There was plenty of variety in the sports classes, and we were definitely pushed to our limits in the best possible way. The food was excellent, and the accommodation was great. Having our own apartment made the experience even more comfortable and relaxing.

Klaus truly knows what he’s doing; his extensive experience really shows. On top of that, he’s genuinely funny too (and yes, that’s impressive for a German 😉). The morning walks with Tom were the perfect start to each day, and his HIIT classes are not to be missed under any circumstances. The Muay Thai trainers were skilled, fun, and provided the perfect, energetic way to end a full training day.

We came straight from a holiday filled with sun, sea, beach, and parties, and we were ready for a fresh start. Palapon gave us exactly that. We’re incredibly happy with the results, the experience, and the amazing new people we met along the way. Highly recommended!

I recently completed the 3-month weight-loss program at Palapon, and it truly changed my life.

I was very out of shape and depressed, I had completely lost control over my health, with no hope to regain it. When the scale hit 103 kg (227 lbs) and was diagnose pre-diabetic, I knew I needed to take serious action.

At Palapon, I got exactly the help I needed I also needed a mental lift, and I found it there. I was lucky to have an amazing group with me, they made me feel welcomed and at home from day 1, and reminded me how much social connections can impact your health just as much as training and nutrition.

I arrived open-minded, and followed the process without question. After all, my own way clearly wasn’t working! The meals were balanced, and I never felt deprived. I also practiced intermittent fasting, and surprisingly, I never felt weak or tired. I highly recommend approaching the program with this mindset, because it works.

I lost 16 kg (35 lbs) — slightly below my initial goal of 20 kg (44 lbs), but I have no regrets, women nearing 50 don't lose as fast as men. What mattered most was consistency and progress. I started very round and soft and finished with visible muscles.

I chose Palapon because I didn’t want a big gym full of perfectly fit people — I wanted a small group of real people like me. And that’s exactly what I found. I met amazing, supportive, and fun people, all sharing similar goals and challenges.

I discovered mobility training, which I’ll definitely keep in my new routine. But my biggest revelation was Muay Thai — I absolutely loved it! I finally found a sport that I enjoy. For anyone who struggles with motivation, finding something you truly love makes all the difference.

Now that I’m back home, I feel hopeful again. I still have about 15 kg (33 lbs) to lose, but it no longer feels impossible.

Klaus is incredibly knowledgeable in conditioning and mobility, and he will not let you fall behind. My advice: leave your ego on the plane, trust the process, and give it your all. Push yourself, ignore the excuses your mind throws at you — but also learn your limits and when to rest. I learned how vital recovery is to real progress, the program is intense, especially when you are not already fit. I did most of it at the beginning and increased the load progressively.

Palapon gave me more than physical results — it gave me hope, confidence, and a love for training again. 💪 . So even if everything wasn't perfect, I achieved what I was here for and more. I would love to do another program to complete my new goal now that I feel stronger. I am definitely happy it was an amazing adventure.

It is clearly one of the best decisions I have made in my life. If you are still hesitating, don’t hesitate anymore : Palapon is a unique place that can truly transform you !

I recently completed a transformative two-week stay at Palapon Fitness Camp. At 47 years old, I'm in reasonable shape, though not nearly as fit as I used to be. Accompanied by a friend, we arrived pleasantly surprised by the well-maintained training complex, complete with beautiful gardens, a pool, and a cabanas.

Klaus, the owner, is not only a gracious host but also an exceptionally knowledgeable trainer. He crafted a superb program that gradually increased in intensity, ensuring it was always challenging yet safe. The Muay Thai and yoga coaches—Dang, Bird, Anna, Ghan, and Chomphu—are top-notch, helping us to progressively enhance our skills and fitness gains.

The meal plan, which included three meals a day for six days a week, was perfectly designed to boost energy, build muscle, and reduce fat. The breakfast consisted of yogurt, museli, protein powder and berries. The other meals, a combination of cuisines including Thai, prepared by Nick and Thi were consistently delicious, satisfying even the pickiest eaters without any cravings for external food. Inspired by the meals, I plan on recreating some of these healthy and tasty dishes back home.

For accommodations, Palapon offers the choice between on-site bungalows and apartment-style residences a five-minute walk away. We opted for the apartments, and recommend this option to enjoy the added privacy, kitchenette, air conditioning, and your own showers—quite necessary after the rigorous workouts.

The stats! Over the two weeks, I lost 3% body fat (2.4 kg), gained 200 g of muscle, and reduced my visceral fat from 3 to 1.9, thanks to the healthy diet. More importantly, I left feeling healthier, stronger, and leaner, with a renewed perspective on food and fitness and healthier habits that I now consider my new normal.

For anyone considering a fitness retreat, I highly recommend Palapon. Make the decision after reading the reviews to change your life. Investing in your health is truly the best decision you can make—it always pays dividends!

Spent 10 days at Palapon in Feb 2023, and I would highly recommend it for anyone with a willingness to lose weight, get fit, or just to change up an unhealthy lifestyle. Owner Klaus and wife Valerie are lovely and really want to help you improve: Klaus will ensure that you put in the work, whilst Valerie's nutritional cooking is actually delicious. His kids are also very nice and helpful. Stay in the villas if you want the convenience of being on-site and to have somewhere close to relax or 'thai shower' between classes, or stay in the apartments (also close by) if you want greater privacy. Pool is relaxing after class, and the Hua Hin area is nice to explore if you have the energy. Trust me though, you may not! Inclusion of massages, body scans and medical tests was a nice touch. The classes are all good, I enjoyed the 'Klaus Fit' (think cross fit) and Muay Thai especially. Yoga was new to me (and more difficult than expected) but the teachers were excellent - and patient! One day a week 'off' is a much needed break that also allows exploration of the wider area, and there are some beautiful sites to visit. Flexible programs are available, I did some surfing whilst a few others were doing kite-surfing lessons alongside a portion of the daily Palapon activities. If you are wanting a luxury Club-Med 5-Star resort-style fitness program this might not be for you, but if you are intent on working hard to improve your life or lose the weight then I suggest going to Palapon. It might not be easy, but you'll get amazing results. I did and the other lovely people around me staying longer even more so. I'll be going back - hopefully next time for a longer to really cement the gains.

Palapon!! Hua Hin's Hidden Muay Thai/ Fitness/Weightloss Sanctaury!

Palapon is a fantastic Muay Thai and fitness camp. The training and the diet is second to none! Excellent regime and great instructors.

What I'd say is... TRUST THE PROCESS.

This was the second time visiting the camp for a 3 week weight loss stint. I was in Palapon before in Feb '24. I was also back there in Nov 24 for 10 x walk-in classes. I absolutely love this sanctuary. I'll be back again soon too.
When walking on to camp you can't but notice the beautifully manicured garden with birds, squirrels and geckos moving around the place. The landscape staff are there most days doing their bit to maintain a fine relaxing environment for the participants!

Klaus is an extremely knowledgeable fitness instructor. He helped me overcome a couple of injury niggles I had before arriving in camp. He architects the training to suit your needs and your abilities. While I was there I learned and developed a good habit mindset. This really helps from techniques, pushing yourself at the right time and diet and what foods are good and bad. He has a mind full of information.

Tap into it while you're there!!!

Klaus is also a very compassionate and empathetic person and helped calm down when receiving bad news from home. He listened and gave me advice and it really helped me.
He's practically minded and to the point.

I'm a firm believer of showing up on time
for class and showing commitment to everything you do! Klaus thrives when he sees this!
I would highly recommend Palapon whether you travelling solo or a couple or with friends.
You'll meet so many different people from all walks of life. It's an absolute education learning about different cultures and environments. Amazing!

From what I've encountered in Palapon, everyone is on the same wavelength bar the odd one or two. People are looking for the same or similar outcome or goal. But they are also seeking a new way of life to be able to take home with them. It's about creating good habits and being able to implement them when arriving home.

The training I won't lie can be tough going especially in the 35C heat. But the satisfaction you get after achieving each class is brilliant.

The accommodation is very good. You have a choice of an on-site camp room or the local Hotel with a decent 25m pool that's 5 mins walk away.

The food is nourishing and is healthy and geared towards your program. Try the intermittent fasting with training! You'll achieve great results.

Thank you so much Klaus! You're a legend and very good friend. Thanks for everything. I'll see you again soon! 🙏💪💯

I had the pleasure of attending camp Palapon for two weeks in December. Before arriving I was afraid it'd be too hot and too intense for me. However even before day 1 Klaus calmed my fears. I arrived with an injured knee and Klaus was able to offer modifications throughout the program. I made great friends, challenged myself, sweat like crazy but I couldn't be happier with my decision to attend camp Palapon. I lost 2.5 kg of fat and gained 2 kg of muscle in less than 2 Weeks. The food is delicious as well.

Palapon – No Nonsense, Outcome Focused, Life-Changing Reboot

I spent one month at Palapon weight loss and fitness camp in Hua Hin, Thailand and would highly recommend this experience to anyone truly interested in a reboot to jump-start a fitness transformation focused on lasting results.

In January 2025 I was the heaviest I have ever been, having neglected my personal fitness for over 5 years.  I knew I needed time to focus intently on restarting fitness habits and searched globally for a program that would best suit my needs.  I was not looking for a luxurious “holiday” fitness destination, but rather a program truly focused on structured exercise, nutrition, and results.  Klaus, owner or Palapon, and his Team delivered.

This is a fantastic venue for weight loss, strength building and physical fitness.  Klaus runs an exceptional exercise class in the mornings,  followed by MuayThai by expert trainers and then yoga classes to name a few classes.

I thoroughly enjoyed my time at Palapon Fitness. I felt fully supported throughout my stay and challenged to the right degree; it was tough, but I never felt like quitting. My favourite class was the 08:30am bodyweight workout which really helped improve both my form and confidence. The yoga and Muay Thai instructors are superb; friendly, supportive people with lots of experience and skill. The food is fresh, healthy and delicious and I felt stronger and fitter after just two weeks there, ready to take on anything. Most importantly, it was a lot of fun!

I did the weight loss program for 6 days in a row and continued for a “lighter version” for 5 more weeks (“only” 2-3days of work out per week + low carb diet, still occasionally enjoying some of the nice local food).
The best results showed when I stayed fully on the program, I nonetheless was very satisfied to notice my body change even the following weeks.

Palapon is a very nice place where all commodities are open air giving it a special vibe. I really liked the variety of work outs offered through the day (from CrossFit, to Yoga, to HIIT session, to Muay Thaï…) and I actually surprised myself missing the exercise on my days off 🙃

One of the highlights of the time there, is the people you meet and “share the pain” with 😅
There is a great sense of community and being around people sharing a common goal felt quite encouraging.

I have left Palapon for more than a month now and I am able to maintain a good work out rythm and better eating habits. I feel proud!

I would like to give a special thanks to Klaus and his team. I always felt welcome and accepted. Klaus is the soul of the place and his strength and willpower were a great inspiration to me. Keep the fire burning 🔥

A friend and I spent two challenging and rewarding weeks at Palapon in April. It was the low-season and initially there was only one other person at the camp and she left soon after we arrived. Instead of being in a large group, the two of us were fortunate to get individualized attention I signed up for the Intensive Fitness Program, and he focused on Muay Thai Training, although many of the classes overlapped.

All of the instructors are professionals who are dedicated to their craft. The three yoga instructors had their own style and way of connecting with students. I was very impressed with their patience and willingness to adjust the class to suit our (my) limitations. Thanks to them my hips are no longer so tight. Klaus led the Body Weight class, which was the most fear inducing and painful activity of the day. The intensity of the movements and the focus on slow, contracted form made it a challenge. Having him stand over us provided added motivation. The Muay Thai instructors were playful but also serious about students getting the most out of the experience. I’m not naturally a puncher or kicker but I learned how to leverage angles for a more powerful kick and how to control my breathing when punching. Initially, the movements felt awkward and I was gassed after every round. By the end I felt more comfortable weaving, bobbing and striking.

Klaus’ son Nick headed up the kitchen, as well as handled miscellaneous duties. The food was uniformly delicious and nutritious. We looked forward to every meal, which was always enough to power us through the day. Nick also gave us many valuable insights into Thai culture and history. His presence reminded us that Palapon is family business that was built from the ground up.

For me the biggest take-aways surrounded good nutrition, consistency and mental toughness. I was already aware that I needed to improve my nutrition and push myself a bit harder. However, there’s a big difference between knowing something and experiencing it first hand. After two weeks I lost 2% body fat and about three kilos. I’m noticeably leaner (I’m 172cm and went from 74KG to 71KG), even if the physical transformation wasn’t huge. Now that I’ve returned to civilian life, I’m more conscious of my workouts and diet. The camp gave me the right tools to continue to improve my overall health.

Final note: The living facilities are a bit rustic. We chose to live in the hotel down the block which was the right decisions for us. Palapon is for people who want to sweat and are willing to grind through the multitude of activities. Like any anything in life, you’ll get out of it what you put in. I highly recommend Palpon to anyone serious about optimizing their health.

Thumbs all the way up for a real holistic fitness experience. During my stay of ten days, I gained a lot of information about my body, how it works and how I could make it work even better. If you are ready to accept the challenge, go for it!

You will work out with Klaus only in the mornings and you might think he is just an ordinary instructor, showing some known moves. In reality, he is a real "sensei", watching you, analysing you, discovering your weaknesses which you are not even aware of and gently approaching you with suggestions - nutrition, exercise, massage, mental fitness boosters, etc. - which leads you to a life changing path. You will work in a small group, and yet Klaus will take care of each and everyone individually, keeping an eye on during the whole day!

This is not a place for those leaving on the surface and urging to share fancy pictures of "things". But, this is a place for the ones who would accept the challenge, commit to goals and respect their instructor and at the end enjoy sharing a fancy picture of their own! Keep in mind that the camp is a camp and if you need facilities, consider staying at the apartment or arrange your own fancy five star.

Palapon team members are all experts on motivating, they will not leave you on your own and push you to make the most out of your retreat. This might be exhausting, considering that you are totally out of your comfort zone. So make sure you bring your inner motivation and full commitment with you.

Overall I would definetly suggest Palapon to those who are ready to face their weaknesses, to learn how to eliminate them and who are committed to reach their goals.

Personalized Support and Small Groups:

Great Food and Varied Training:

Unjustified Criticisms:

I cannot understand the criticisms expressed in other reviews. I never saw the dogs in any training area. They were always on the lawns. And the occasional bird dropping is simply unavoidable in nature and probably happens at every outdoor restaurant/cafe in Thailand.

Problems were resolved immediately:

Minor issues that arose during my stay were immediately resolved by the owner or the trainers.

Conclusion:

I can recommend this fitness camp to anyone looking for effective training in a stunning setting. I had a fantastic time here.

No mass tourism, but rather an individualized program.
